submittedPrompt:
Create one complete new literary-room companion mother artwork for cell anon/attention/violet, horizontal EXACT 1536 × 1024. TWO clean image inputs have distinct roles: IMAGE 1 is the target-theme EMPTY room, sole authority for room camera, furniture, view and full lighting. IMAGE 2 is the root-personally-approved APRICOT attention mother of THIS SAME Anon, a continuity reference for her correct youthful identity, clothing, actual seated body support, real object and human scale. Repaint the whole person and room into one unified target light field. Do NOT paste/cut out a figure, apply a flat color overlay, retain the sunny seed background, borrow another character, or create a UI screenshot.

这是千早爱音／千早 愛音，MyGO!!!!!，不是祥子换色。她有长粉发与分束刘海、清楚灰蓝眼，青春学生的柔软面颊和不过长的轻下颌，聪明鲜活而非婴儿、木偶或成熟泛脸。羽丘原作服装结构：灰紫校服外套、浅色滚边、小金纽扣、白衬衫、深绿斜条领带、深绿与黄绿/金线格裙、深绿色膝下小腿长袜（袜口在膝以下、膝盖露出）、完整黑色乐福鞋。固有绿只属于衣服和自然植物，不成为绿色UI或全局染色。各色在当前光下自然变化，不能统一改灰。没有大型发饰，不加祥子的深发带、乐奈异色眼或猫元素。

本幅相处，先有自己的事与真实共同对象：
她本来正读自己的薄册，听见相熟的人轻轻叫她，眼神先从页上回到对方，头只跟着转一点；一指仍留在朴素书签旁的页边，另一手托册，原念头还在。眉梢有一个清楚但不催促的疑问，嘴唇将启未启，不机械复制头像的笑，不向空气硬指。没有下一句话也容许这个瞬间停住。
这是项目原创的相处设想，册面只保留微淡不可读纸纹，不画能读出的引语、姓名、日期、历史消息、已经准备完成的声明或工具回执。

Exact target creative brief, all details apply as a living moment rather than mechanical labels:
id: anon/attention/violet
character: anon
activity: attention
palette: violet
title: 被轻轻叫到，念头还留在原处
psychology: 她正在看自己的册页，听见轻轻一声呼唤，先用目光回应。手指还压着原处，事情没有因此被清空。 好奇想立刻问一句，也能把注意交出来而不催着对方给任务。 被叫到的一刻让安静有了轻轻的回声。
gaze: 眼神先从页上转向来人，头部只随之轻微转动。 先看人，再看对方可能指向的近处。
relating: 接住一次没有明确任务的呼唤，容许相处就停在这一眼。 等待下一句，也容许没有下一句。
expression: 眉梢有询问，嘴角放松，神情未急着替人下结论。 嘴唇将启未启，眼里带柔和好奇。
posture: 坐在长凳上，薄册由膝托着，一指自然留在页边。
support: window-bench-near-table
props: 同一本薄册与一条朴素书签；不新增提示面板。
composition: 目光和手中仍保留的页形成关系，圆几和窗景不换位。
lighting: 瓷灯照面与页，暮色完整包住窗外。

暮色紫／完整黄昏：严格沿第一张空景紫灰山、玫瑰暮云、湖岸初灯与室内暖瓷灯。靠窗侧有轻紫灰环境反光，靠灯侧温暖，衣料/手/脸/木头一起接受该光场。不可一半白天一半夜晚、不可金色晴天窗。
Material continuity: local shadow planes must still describe young face, hands, cloth folds, white collar, dark-green socks, black loafers and pink hair. Keep eyes/bangs readable in the room scale. Natural warmth is a relation of the actual light sources, never a global amber/gray wash. Expressions follow this activity's exact brief, not a universal grin or Sakiko avatar smile.

Preserve IMAGE 1's complete close literary camera and mild perspective: large wooden window, same autumn lake town/mountains, ivory curtains, left writing desk and its original wood chair, shelf books/frames/plants, original round side table with blue-white porcelain lamp/cup/books/flowers, long wood window bench, linen cushion, right plaid cushions and knitted throw, wood floor/rug and softly blurred foreground plant. No furniture added or translated, no zoom/crop, moved window, extra desktop or floating stool. One person only, no extra off-camera hand. Table remains near original x435–690/top y500, left desk ends near x400 and chair stays near x260; these are room relations, not instructions to stretch the person.

Retain the approved activity's real placement on the ACTUAL BENCH: the near-table bench position, leaving the table its original room. Hips and thighs visibly rest on and compress the cushion, knees connect through natural lower legs and ankles to complete black loafers with honest floor/contact shadows. Preserve the near-camera whole-body scale and complete visible head/hands/knees/shoes; do not lengthen shins, enlarge head, distort joints, or move furniture merely to fit a rectangle. Parallel or gently offset legs must be coherent, not a crossed-knee pose pretending two parallel flat feet. No fused hands, extra fingers, broken wrists or unsupported paper. Existing foreground occlusion stays honest; never move a limb into a gap without support.

Keep real open visual breathing room on BOTH sides of the character, respecting the seed's useful placement and the intact room; leave the left desk/window air and the free right cushion/window readable. Do not add gray/white panels, fake content, bright blank cards or an artificial UI safe-zone. No collaged edges, stickers, labels, borders, logos, icons, overlays, arrows, watermark or split day/night. Refined fresh TWO-DIMENSIONAL hand-drawn anime figure and soft painted room must share the same air, light and contact; no official near-3D model material. Produce the whole coherent scene as a new original image.
